tagMethod: shapeTags are computed from the tree (see shapeEvidence): rs-cfg-feature-heavy = at least 15 #[cfg(/#[cfg_attr(/cfg!( sites per 1,000 hand-written Rust lines, or at least 75 [features] entries across Cargo manifests; js-mixed-cjs-esm = non-test hand-written .js/.cjs/.mjs files include both CommonJS (require(, module.exports, exports.x) and ESM (import/export statements); TS/JS tags apply only to tsjs and polyglot entries. shapeTagsJudged are lead judgements for review.

sizeMethod.unit: physical lines (newline count, plus one for a final unterminated line) of git blobs at the pinned commit
sizeMethod.basis: hand-written lines of the entry's languageGroup: rust=.rs; tsjs=.ts .tsx .mts .cts .js .jsx .mjs .cjs (incl. .d.ts); python=.py .pyi; polyglot=rust+tsjs
sizeMethod.vendored: a path segment in {vendor, vendored, _vendor, third_party, third-party, node_modules, bower_components}, or root .gitattributes linguist-vendored
sizeMethod.generated: not vendored, and a path segment in {generated, __generated__, gen, codegen-out}, or a .generated./.gen. name, or *.min.js, or root .gitattributes linguist-generated, or a marker in the first 1 KiB (@generated, 'generated code', 'DO NOT EDIT', 'auto-generated', 'autogenerated', 'Generated by', 'This file was automatically generated')
sizeMethod.testOrExample: reported, not excluded: a path segment in {tests, test, __tests__, testing, fixtures, __fixtures__, examples, example, benches, bench, docs_src, e2e, playground, spec, __snapshots__, testdata} or a test_/.test./.spec./_test name
sizeMethod.limitations: heuristic classifier; per-entry overrides are recorded in sizeBasis.classOverride and notes

contentDigestAlgorithm.definition: SHA-256 over the concatenation, in ascending byte order of path, of: '<mode> <type> <h> ' + path + NUL, for every entry of `git ls-tree -r --full-tree <commit>`. For a blob, h is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw blob bytes (symlink blobs hash their target text; LFS pointers hash the pointer bytes). For a gitlink (type commit), h is the recorded commit SHA-1.
contentDigestAlgorithm.why: The git tree SHA-1 pins the commit's tree, and this SHA-256 adds a collision-resistant check over the same bytes.
